description: Tasks 3.1 + 3.2: the ingest/ package -- pypdfium2 PDF rendering (adaptive DPI + one-shot small-font raise + text-layer extraction with the single point->pixel coordinate conversion), Pillow + pillow-heif image loaders for all formats (incl. multi-page TIFF + HEIC) reusing the M2 decompression-bomb guards, born-digital-vs-scanned detection, and the individually-toggleable preprocessing pipeline. Adds the real born_digital_math.pdf (generated), scanned_page.png, text_en.png, text_id.png, and skewed_scan.png fixtures. Depends on FEAT-001 (venv + IngestConfig + settings).
steps: Create engine/texora_engine/ingest/base.py: SourceKind StrEnum (pdf_born_digital/pdf_scanned/image); PdfTextSpan(text, bbox:tuple[float,float,float,float] in rendered-image pixels, font_size_pt, is_mathish=False); RenderedPage(index, width, height, dpi, kind, text_layer:list[PdfTextSpan]|None) -- JSON-serializable, NO PIL image on the model. Full type hints, Pydantic v2.

Create engine/texora_engine/ingest/pdf.py: open with pypdfium2.PdfDocument(path), iterate pages lazily (one bitmap at a time, M4-ready). Adaptive DPI: render at settings ingest base_dpi (260); estimate median glyph cap-height (born-digital: from the text layer; scanned: fast connected-component estimate); re-render EXACTLY ONCE at min(base_dpi*1.5, max_dpi) when median_span_font_pt * base_dpi / 72 < small_font_px (design N1 -- state the pt->px conversion explicitly). Use page.render(scale=dpi/72).to_pil() -> RGB. Text-layer extraction via page.get_textpage(): build PdfTextSpans converting pdfium point coords (origin bottom-left, 72dpi) to rendered-image pixels (origin top-left, effective DPI) -- this is the ONLY coordinate-conversion site. Free bitmaps promptly.

Create engine/texora_engine/ingest/images.py: register_heif_opener() once at import; load PNG/JPG/JPEG/WEBP/BMP via Pillow, multi-page TIFF via ImageSequence (each frame -> a RenderedPage kind=IMAGE), HEIC/HEIF via pillow-heif. Reuse the M2 decompression-bomb guards (Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS + area/edge/byte bounds from settings); a decode failure or over-bounds image raises a typed error (the API later maps to 422), never crashes a run.

Create engine/texora_engine/ingest/detect.py: pure per-page classifier -> SourceKind. A page is born-digital iff pdfium reports extractable text >= born_digital_char_threshold chars AND the text bboxes cover >= born_digital_coverage of the page area; else scanned. Pure function over the pdfium text page.

Create engine/texora_engine/ingest/preprocess.py: one pure function per step (deskew via OpenCV minAreaRect/Hough within +-15deg, skip if |angle|<0.3deg; denoise fastNlMeansDenoising/median for scanned only; binarize adaptive Sauvola/Otsu default-off; perspective four-point default-off; auto_crop foreground bbox trim with small pad) and a `preprocess(img, cfg:PreprocessSettings, kind:SourceKind)->Image` applying enabled steps in the fixed order deskew->perspective->denoise->binarize->auto_crop, each returning a new image with the previous freed. A disabled step is a no-op; born-digital pages default to no preprocessing unless forced.
Create engine/texora_engine/ingest/__init__.py re-exporting the loaders + PageImage/RenderedPage/SourceKind types.

Add the fixtures under engine/tests/fixtures/: born_digital_math.pdf -- generate reproducibly by adding/extending a generator in scripts/ (title + a paragraph with one inline formula + one numbered display equation, two-column on one page; license-clean, regenerable); scanned_page.png (rasterized scanned-style page); text_en.png (cropped English text line/block); text_id.png (cropped Indonesian text with ID diacritics); skewed_scan.png (+ a small expected/metadata companion recording the known skew angle for the before/after assertion).

Write engine/tests/test_ingest_pdf.py (renders the fixture PDF to a PIL image at the expected size; small-font raise re-renders exactly once; point->pixel conversion matches a known span on the fixture), test_ingest_images.py (loads each format incl. multi-page TIFF + HEIC; over-bounds image raises the typed guard error), test_ingest_detect.py (positive on born_digital_math.pdf, negative on scanned_page.png), and test_preprocess.py (each toggle false -> output pixels identical to input; deskew true on skewed_scan.png reduces the measured skew below threshold).
acceptance_criteria: `pytest tests/test_ingest_pdf.py tests/test_ingest_images.py tests/test_ingest_detect.py tests/test_preprocess.py -q` passes all tests.
pdf.py renders born_digital_math.pdf and the small-font-raise logic re-renders at most once (asserted).
The pdfium point->pixel coordinate conversion matches the known fixture span within tolerance (asserted).
images.py loads PNG/JPG/WEBP/BMP/TIFF(multi-frame)/HEIC and rejects an over-bounds image with the typed guard error.
detect.py classifies the born-digital PDF as born-digital and the scanned image as scanned.
Each preprocess toggle is respected (disabled step = byte-identical no-op; deskew reduces skew).
verification: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ingest_pdf.py tests/test_ingest_images.py tests/test_ingest_detect.py tests/test_preprocess.py -q

cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check . && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m black --check . --line-length 100 && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m mypy texora_engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q
findings: ingest/ package landed under engine/texora_engine/ingest/ (base, pdf, images, detect, preprocess, __init__). FULL GATE GREEN on this host: feature modules 24 passed; ruff clean; black clean (60 files); mypy clean (38 files); full pytest 88 passed, 3 skipped (the pre-existing M2 model-gated skips, unchanged). TYPES later features consume: SourceKind StrEnum = pdf_born_digital|pdf_scanned|image. RenderedPage(index:int>=0, width:int>0, height:int>0, dpi:int>0, kind:SourceKind, text_layer:list[PdfTextSpan]|None) is JSON-serializable and carries NO PIL image; the bitmap is returned ALONGSIDE as a separate PIL.Image the caller must .close(). PdfTextSpan(text:str, bbox:tuple[x0,y0,x1,y1] in RENDERED-IMAGE PIXELS top-left origin, font_size_pt:float, is_mathish:bool=False) -- is_mathish is set to False by the loader and is the born-digital math heuristic's field to fill (FEAT for layout/born_digital). text_layer is a list of PER-CHARACTER spans (the stable pdfium primitive), whitespace chars dropped; the born-digital layout detector must cluster chars->lines->blocks itself. IngestError (in ingest/base.py) is the typed load/decode/over-bounds error the API maps to 422. PUBLIC API: iter_pdf_pages(path, cfg:IngestConfig)->Iterator[(RenderedPage, PIL.Image)] (lazy, one bitmap at a time, M4-ready; caller MUST close each image before the next), render_pdf_page(pdf, index, cfg), open_pdf(path) ctx manager; load_image_pages(path, settings:Settings)->list[(RenderedPage, PIL.Image)] (multi-page TIFF => one pair per frame, kind=IMAGE, dpi metadata=96); preprocess(img, cfg:PreprocessSettings, kind:SourceKind)->PIL.Image. COORDINATE CONVERSION (the ONLY site): ingest/pdf.py::_pt_to_px_bbox -- pdfium get_charbox returns (left,bottom,right,top) in POINTS, origin bottom-left; conversion x_px=x_pt*dpi/72, y_px=(page_height_pt - y_pt)*dpi/72 (vertical flip, PDF 'top' -> smaller pixel-y). Verified: fixture title 'E' pt box ~(170.36,740.0,181.20,751.92) on 612x792pt @260dpi -> px bbox ~(615.2,144.7,654.3,187.8), renderer span matches within <0.5px. DETECT: classify_pdf_page(page, w_pt, h_pt, cfg) pure over the pdfium text page; born-digital iff non-whitespace char count >= cfg.born_digital_char_threshold (default 20) AND union-bbox coverage >= cfg.born_digital_coverage (default 0.05); coverage uses the OVERALL text bounding rectangle (axis-independent so points-space == pixels-space). PREPROCESS: strict no-op contract -- a disabled step returns the SAME image object (byte-identical); preprocess NEVER closes the caller-owned input, only its own intermediates. Fixed order deskew->perspective->denoise->binarize->auto_crop. denoise is scanned-only (skipped for PDF_BORN_DIGITAL even if flag on). Skew sign: estimate_skew_deg folds OpenCV minAreaRect (angle in (0,90]) to [-45,45] via (angle-90 when >45); correction is img.rotate(angle) (PIL CCW-positive matches the estimator sign); deskew skipped when |angle|<0.3deg or >15deg. FIXTURES under engine/tests/fixtures/ (all reproducible + license-clean): born_digital_math.pdf (hand-written Type1-font PDF: title + two-column body w/ one inline 'E = mc2' + one numbered display equation '(1)'; regen: scripts/gen_born_digital_pdf.py), scanned.pdf (image-only, text-layer-free -- the DETECT NEGATIVE; same generator), scanned_page.png, text_en.png, text_id.png, skewed_scan.png + skewed_scan.json (skew_angle_deg=7.0), sample.jpg/.webp/.bmp/.heic, multipage.tiff (2 frames) (regen: scripts/gen_ingest_image_fixtures.py). NOTE for FEAT-003 (layout/text/factory): the two scripts/ generators are deterministic and committed; re-run them if fixtures need extending. mypy overrides extended with pypdfium2.*, pillow_heif.*, cv2.* (numpy stays strictly typed via numpy.typing.NDArray). No new dependency => no docs/LICENSES.md row needed (all pinned in FEAT-001). tasks.md 3.1 + 3.2 ticked [x]; docs/m3-verification.md has a FEAT-002 section with real command output. pyproject setuptools packages gained texora_engine.ingest.
